question: In which process is a solid substance volatilised by heating and the vapour is condensed back to the solid at a cold surface?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Sublimation.**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Sublimation **is a process of **conversion of a substance from the solid to the gaseous state without its becoming liquid.**
 
• This phenomenon is the result of vapour pressure and temperature relationships.
 
• It is a type of phase transition.
 
• **Example: Camphor, Dry ice, solid CO₂.**
 
• In the sublimation process, this reaction is an endothermic reaction, as the chemical bonds between molecules are broken down in to release them into the air.
 
• So, sublimation is defined as heat/energy required to change the state from solid to gas.
 
• It is expressed as** KJ/Mol or KJ/kg.**

**​** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Chromatography: **

 
 
• **​**Chromatography is a technique which is used in the laboratory for the separation of a mixture into its components.
 
• There are mainly **4 types of chromatography**: Gas chromatography, high-performance liquid chromatography, thin-layered chromatography and paper chromatography.
 
 
 
• **Filtration: **
 
 
• It is the process in which solid particles in a liquid or gaseous fluid are removed by the use of a filter medium that permits the fluid to pass through but retains the solid particles.
 
 
 
• **Distillation: **
 
 
• It is the process of separating the components of a liquid mixture through selective evaporation and condensation.
 
• It is a reversible process. This is useful in obtaining a pure liquid from non-volatile impurities.
 
• Dry distillation is a process in which destructive distillation of solid products to convert them into gaseous products.
